name: Voskhod
credit: Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.

flights.flight_designation: Voskhod 1 (1964-10-12) · Komarov + Feoktistov + Yegorov — first three-person crewed spaceflight; no spacesuits (fit three crew in a Vostok-derived hull)
Voskhod 2 (1965-03-18) · Belyayev + Leonov — first EVA (Leonov, 12 min); suit ballooned, required venting; manual landing in remote Urals forest
